n1.speaker: npc_pell
n1.text: You came. Shut the door. Quietly; the hinges report to someone.

n2.speaker: npc_pell
n2.text: The Tarrow file. Violet ink. I have seen it before, and I have watched good clerks stop asking about it.

n3.speaker: npc_pell
n3.text: Every new file that comes up to you, read it for violet. Each forged line is a soul somebody sold. Bring me the count.
